name: cold_angle_v1
hypothesis: Opening with what a quiet quote already cost them (survey visit, paperwork) gets more positive replies than opening with a question about how many went quiet.
variable: opening angle (offer line = winner of cold_offer_v1; swap it in before running)
decision_rule: Run after cold_offer_v1 is decided. Keep the arm with >= 90% probability of the higher positive-reply rate; otherwise keep the one with more booked calls.

arms.subject: quotes that went quiet
arms.body:
Hi,

How many quotes has {company} sent out in the last year where the homeowner just went quiet?

I chase those people up for you, in your name, and book anyone who's still interested back in for a survey. Nothing to pay unless it works.

Worth me sending over how it works?

arms.subject: old quotes
arms.body:
Hi,

Every quote that goes quiet has already cost you a survey visit and an evening on the paperwork. Most of those homeowners never actually said no. They just went quiet.

I chase them for you, in your name, and book the ones still interested back in. Nothing to pay unless it works.

Worth a look for {company}?
